bleedSpeedExtension.predicate: opponent currently carries Fillet-owned bleed; not Fillet self-status
bleedSpeedExtension.rounding: positive field * percent //100; apply saved direction afterward
bleedSpeedExtension.activation: Walk/run recompute effective target every actionable movement tick. Run acceleration grows toward new cap; no direct vx multiplication. Clamp running vx to reduced cap when bleed ends. Ground backdash/airdash snapshot their effective speed on action entry; expiry does not retime a committed action. Run-jump carries existing vx naturally; no additional air multiplier.
bleedSpeedExtension.attack: On attack entry inherit already-boosted velocity once then apply move inertia. Never multiply attack travel or inherited vx again.

clockContract.current: Increments on every Simulation::step, including hitstop, stage travel and resolved winner. Input edges/facing sampled before hitstop return.
clockContract.proposal: Preserve 60Hz sample/history clock; 5-world-tick button buffer and 20/8-world-tick motion search remain.

clockContract.current: Stops during hitstop/stage travel. Bleed timers, projectile simulation and round timer use it; individual counter slowdown does not pause them.
clockContract.proposal: Preserve. Shared paired-action clock also uses this clock; clear pre-existing individual counter slowdown on capture.

clockContract.current: Stops during hitstop and every alternate held counter-slow tick; controls, position, move age, dash pause/age, stun, landing and recovery advance here.
clockContract.proposal: Preserve; all authored move/locomotion/defense clips use saved actor state, never render delta.

clockContract.current: update_faultless runs before hitstop early return; drains meter and reserves chords even during hitstop/actor slow-held ticks.
clockContract.proposal: Preserve this explicit exception unless a later global defense revision changes it.

clockContract.current: Godot _process reads model state; FighterArt selects atlas pose from core. No body render clock or interpolation. Camera impact timer can advance through freeze.
clockContract.proposal: Body poses remain deterministic and simulation-owned. No time-based crossfade or visual-root interpolation that can outrun collision.

attackTransitionContract.frameConvention: Action f1 is the input-accepted simulation tick. Windup f1..S-1, active fS..S+A-1, recovery fS+A..S+A+R-1. Inputs can execute on following tick. Each tick has one resolved pose/collision record, saved for rollback.
attackTransitionContract.entry: No added ready-to-attack delay. Select first anticipation key on f1 from idle/walk/run/crouch; apply move advance/inertia before integration. Cancel begins new move f1 immediately.
attackTransitionContract.poseKeyPartition: Per-action exact keys in Fillet_V1 implementation_v0_2.json supersede a generic percentage partition. Hold resolved pose/geometry keys on actor action clocks.
attackTransitionContract.recovery: Author recovery pose keys instead of returning to ready while still recovering. Last recovery tick remains its last pose/boxes; idle begins only on next actionable tick, unless hit/block/landing/cancel supersedes it.
attackTransitionContract.inertiaApplication: At begin choose carry velocity only if its magnitude exceeds current vx, consume carry, then truncate toward zero(vx*move.inertiaPercent/100), clamp±4000. No second bleed multiplier. Translate x byvx, then authored startupTravel/activeTravel, then drag90 toward zero each actor tick.
attackTransitionContract.carryLifetime: Retain current 5-tick window including source movement tick: timer5 stored after run/step travel; decremented before control; usable for four subsequent action ticks. No repeated restoration on later gatlings.
attackTransitionContract.perMoveOwnership: advance, startupTravel, travelSpeed, inertiaPercent, airborne friction exception if any, landingRecovery and any special phase motion must be explicitly filled in the central move table. Suggested normal inertia40–70%; all throws and Wound0%. These suggestions are not approval.
attackTransitionContract.stopAndRestart: Walking/stopping/crouching does not automatically resume a prior run; held forward after recovery produces walk unless a fresh dash edge survives buffer. Interrupted clips never resume; attacks increment serial and reset pose phase.
attackTransitionContract.airAttack: Dash burst vx is set before attack entry; per-move inertia applies. Base vy continues ballistic unless move explicitly overrides it. Attack friction90 applies horizontally even in air. Air-action landing minimum3 except explicitly approved move branch.
attackTransitionContract.facing: Latch action facing at acceptance; only explicitly authored exceptions apply (central236K one update afterf20). Otherwise lockthroughrecovery.
attackTransitionContract.visualSettle: Locomotion andpaired global render offsets are0. Central attack notes may author up to4px internalbody settle inside agreed collision envelope; this is drawing deformation, not extra physical root or doubled travel.

facingPolicy.autoFace: On beginning of an eligible free actionable tick, before interpreting buffered relative inputs. Lock while attack, backdash, air dash, capture, hitstop, stun, hit reel, knockdown/waking or landing recovery.
facingPolicy.turnAnimation: 2 interruptible actor ticks, no gameplay delay, no weapon hand swap. Air-cross turn allowed on next free airborne actionable tick only.
facingPolicy.airDashDirection: Snapshot facing/direction at dash accept; cross-under never changes burst direction.
facingPolicy.backThrow: Explicit exchange atrelease then facing flips once.
facingPolicy.differenceFromCurrent: Current core auto-faces every world tick whenever move<0, including hitstop/reaction/capture; changing that requires saved lock state.
facingPolicy.perMoveException: Central236K has exactlyone target-relative update afterframe20, thenlocks again. No other action inherits this exception.

interruptAndResetPolicy.attackOrJump: Legal input replaces locomotion immediately, discards transition animation, does not append startup. Input order remains jump then attacks then dash.
interruptAndResetPolicy.hit: Immediate hurt/reel pose; clear move/run/dash/carry/landing/prejump and buffered locomotion phase resume token; keep history so fresh last5worldtick reversal input works.
interruptAndResetPolicy.block: Immediate contact block pose; clear movement and carry; new contact resets4-tick settle timer.
interruptAndResetPolicy.land: Reset air quotas exactly once on y-crossing; zero vx on locked air-action landing; empty landing retains current ground steering rules.
interruptAndResetPolicy.FD: Ground stops movement and clears carry; air cancels dash, preserves current horizontal vx and resumes gravity. Cannot start during selected committed backdash or airdash pause.
interruptAndResetPolicy.roundReset: x420/580px,facing+1/-1,y/vx/vy0; move=-1; all new clip/phase/locks/pair fields0; bleed cleared; quotas0; idle startsI0.
interruptAndResetPolicy.rollback: Snapshot every new gait accumulator, clip age, facing lock, dash speed snapshot, pairId/tick/anchors and status multiplier state; replay must reproduce pose and boxes exactly.

pairedThrowGuide.coordinates: Root-track values are world pixels relative to owner root at successful contact, oriented by captured facing; convert exactly *100. Interpolate linearly in raw integers with truncation toward zero at each C tick. Visual offset always[0,0]; these are physical scripted roots during capture, not a render-only teleport.
pairedThrowGuide.wholePairWallClamp: For each tick compute the two scripted roots including each fighter push halfWidth; translate both by same minimal x correction so both fit[0,100000]. Preserve relative gap and side order. Final120/170px gap must survive either corner.
pairedThrowGuide.roleLocks: Capture assigns immutable owner/victim/entryFacing/entryRoot. Clear individualcounter slow andmovement/carry; owner/victim cannot act,guard,FD orreceive independent hits while paired. Inputs continue sampling. Normal-throw tech is the sole specialized capture-input exception in C1–6. Ordinary last5worldtick actionedges maybuffer into roleunlock.

handAndWeaponOwnership.rightHand: Always long knife; may cut or hold clear, never becomes the short knife.
handAndWeaponOwnership.leftHand: Always short knife; catches use forearm/pommel/closed-fist structure while blade points down/outward, not an unexplained empty hand.
handAndWeaponOwnership.handRelease: Contact lock must turn off at explicit phase boundary (Wound C17, ordinary C17, cashouts C21). Neither victim nor weapon follows a released socket afterward.
handAndWeaponOwnership.socketRequirement: Author per-pose right_hand, left_hand, right_knife_root/tip, left_knife_root/tip, left_forearm_contact and victim_contact anchors. Measured coordinates must be filled from approved art; root tracks and exact collision above already define gameplay. These anatomy sockets are not present in current manifest.
handAndWeaponOwnership.schematicPairedAnchor: While upright roots are60px apart, owner forearm local[28,88] and victim chest local[32,88] with victim facing-ownerFacing meet at same world point. This is a selected planning anchor, not measured existing anatomy. For prone/rising Wound, author corresponding32/45/68/88px contact-height keys without changing collision or root tracks.

pairedThrowGuide.postRelease: Grounded ready/crouch-to-ready role clips consume exactly listed recovery counters; no new knockdown/wakeup appended. Restore per-character ready hurt/push geometry on release; during role recovery cannot guard/act. Victim throw grace5 starts on first unlocked tick. No ordinary throw/cashout may chain to Wound solely because this sequence visually tumbles the victim.
pairedThrowGuide.currentContrast: No Fillet move currently uses captured pair animation. Generic capture uses one fixed60px offset and generic victim hurt pose; current normal throws and conditional5D cashout apply immediately.
pairedThrowGuide.sourceApproach: 236D is grounded before capture (rooty0 byf21); C1–4 normalizes landed hop posture, never adds aerial capture.214D enters from its authored slide/rise. Wound rejects already-owned bleed.

normalThrowTechBranch.scope: Universal ordinary ground throws only; not Fillet-only. Wound and command cashouts are not techable.
normalThrowTechBranch.acceptWindow: Check at the start of entering C1..C6, before advancing that tick; completed pair ticks are0..5. C7 is too late. The existing simultaneous legal ground-capture clash at C0 uses the same symmetric break outcome.
normalThrowTechBranch.input: P+K held with at least one new P/K edge, either direction; old held chord does not auto-tech. Specialized pair handler uses ordinary5-world-tick history, so only still-buffered edges from capture freeze can resolve at C1. Consume chord on acceptance.
normalThrowTechBranch.rootEvent: At accepted tech T0 preserve current side order and center midpoint, set roots120px apart using whole-pair wall clamp; zero vx/vy/carry. Release contact immediately; then6 shared freeze ticks. This is declared physical push displacement, not visual root drift.
normalThrowTechBranch.recovery: After freeze, T1..T12 equal role-recovery ticks; T13 both actionable. PosesT1..4 recoil/arms disengage,T5..8 plant feet,T9..12 ready. No attack/jump/guard/FD during recovery.
normalThrowTechBranch.collision: Restore ordinary body/push onT1 after shared freeze. Strikes can interrupt a role normally; normal throw/capture eligibility rejects recovery. No new strike invulnerability. On hit clear that role tech recovery and enter ordinary hit state; other role finishes own remaining lock. +0 assumes neither is subsequently hit.
normalThrowTechBranch.poseOwnership: Both knives remain in their physical hands; left forearm contact unlocks atT0. No side exchange even if back throw was attempted.

postAirDashCoastExtension.entry: Only after natural completion of fifth burst tick (overall f9), set airDashCoastPending. Atstart of overall f10 before buffered inputs, clamp abs(vx) and abs(carryVx) to current eligible cap, preserving signs; clear pending and setcoastMode.
postAirDashCoastExtension.continuedCoast: No extra free-air drag. Clamp again to650 if bleed expires while coasting; entering bleed does not multiply existing vx. Steering reversal sets ordinary380. Grounding, an attack, hit/block, FD, new dash or reset clears coastMode.
postAirDashCoastExtension.earlyBurstCancel: If attack accepted f5..f9 before dash completes, use2000/2200×move inertia and friction90. No coast clamp that tick and no old dash carry afterattack.
postAirDashCoastExtension.runJump: Do not apply coast cap to a run jump that has not naturally finished an air dash.

5-9.jump: No extra air jumps for Fillet; a configured future quota would be evaluated normally.
5-9.order: Set new burst vx, then inspect buffered actions; attack replaces dash before translation and applies inertia. Ordinary air guard is allowed holding back; FD cancels dash.
5-9.gravity: suppressed while remainingdash>0; finalburst tick resumes gravity after vertical integration
